agency: Law enforcement agency name, standardized by the publisher.
agency_id: Publisher agency identifier; join the two tables within this snapshot.
ORI9: Originating Agency Identifier(s) matched by the publisher; may be a semicolon-separated string or missing. Split associations explicitly before joining.
agreement_id: Publisher identifier for one agreement; unique in this snapshot.
support_type: Agreement model: Task Force, Jail Enforcement, Warrant Service Officer or historical combined model.
jurisdiction: Publisher description of the jurisdiction covered by the agreement.
jurisdiction_facilities: Publisher text describing facility locations covered by a facility-based agreement; often absent for other models.
jurisdiction_level_source: Source or method used to assign the jurisdiction level.
status: Active, Removed or Superseded as of this source snapshot.
signed_date: Reported agreement signing date; not a measured implementation or training date.
first_appeared_date: First observed listing date; in agencies, the source aggregate across agreements can preserve missing values. NULL does not mean never listed.
first_appeared_source: Source supporting the first observed listing.
last_appeared_date: Last observed listing date; in agencies, the source aggregate can preserve missing values. Not an exact termination date; NULL does not mean never listed.
removed_by_date: First observation showing removal; upper bound on termination timing when present.
removal_flag: Publisher review flag related to removal; preserve the original value and consult the codebook before recoding.
moa: Link to the memorandum of agreement; some agreements lack an archived document.
moa_pending: Publisher flag for an agreement document that is pending.
addendum: Link to a first agreement addendum, when present.
addendum_second: Link to a second agreement addendum, when present.
addendum_signed_date: Signing date for the first addendum, when present.
addendum_signed_date_second: Signing date for the second addendum, when present.
has_addendum: Publisher indicator that an addendum exists.
place: Mapped place name, where applicable; not an applicant or detainee residence.
place_type: Publisher classification of the mapped place.
place_geoid: Census place identifier where applicable; preserve leading zeros.
county: Mapped county name; scope can extend beyond an individual county.
county_fips: Mapped county FIPS text, possibly multiple semicolon-separated associations; preserve leading zeros and split before joins.
state_fips: State FIPS text; preserve leading zeros.
geoid: Publisher geographic join identifier; interpret jointly with geoid_type.
ice_county: County text from the ICE source listing, which may differ from standardized geography.
ice_type: Agency-type text from the ICE source listing.
latest_sheet_row: Row reference in the latest source spreadsheet used for the agreement.
latest_sheet: Latest source spreadsheet identifier recorded by the publisher.
geometry_type: Publisher geometry-type label; missing for the 406 empty geometries.
geometry_vintage: Vintage year for the jurisdiction geometry, when reported; not the agreement year.
geometry_wkb: OGC WKB BLOB converted from original geometry with ST_AsWKB. Empty geometries are preserved and are not SQL NULL. Original CRS metadata is retained.
has_active: Whether the agency has at least one Active agreement in this snapshot.
n_agreements: Number of agreement rows for this agency, including historical rows.
n_active: Number of Active agreement rows for this agency.
last_removed_by_date: Latest removal-observation bound for agencies with no Active agreement. NULL while any agreement is Active, or when missing upstream; not an exact agency exit date.
first_signed_date: Earliest agreement signing date for the agency.
last_signed_date: Latest agreement signing date for the agency.
models: Publisher summary of agreement models associated with the agency.
model_history: Publisher text summarizing model history; retain its format rather than treating it as a new observation.
